text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 101 million markka median forecast for foodstuffs, animal feed and bakery group Cultor Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax:
Cultor's four-month results are due on May 28 at 0900/0600 GMT. In January-April 1996, Cultor posted a 49 million markka profit.
In March, Cultor said it was expecting full-year 1997 earnings per share to come close to the 14.91 markka reported in 1995 (when profit after financial items was FIM 494 million).
The median of nine analysts' forecasts for Cultor's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 510 million markka (mean 506 million) in a 460-543 million markka range.
Cultors' full-year 1996 profit was 391 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
